units.title: Verify: validateWorld scene character path and count unit tests

tests.id: validator.test.ts::validateWorld scene characters > tags the index of the second unknown character
tests.name: tags the index of the second unknown character
tests.title: validateWorld scene characters: tags the index of the second unknown character
tests.scenario: Given scene characters [boy, ghost] where only boy is in the world list, When validateWorld runs, Then the only error is 'scenes[bedroom].characters[1].id: unknown character ghost'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t "second unknown character" --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: 1 passed, 8 skipped. Passes on current implementation; not observed red because the check already exists.

tests.id: validator.test.ts::validateWorld scene characters > reports no character error when scene.characters is undefined
tests.name: reports no character error when scene.characters is undefined
tests.title: validateWorld scene characters: reports no character error when scene.characters is undefined
tests.scenario: Given a valid scene with no characters field, When validateWorld runs, Then no error contains 'characters['
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passes as part of the full validator file (9/9).

units.title: Verify: BootScene character spawn, fallback and shutdown unit tests

tests.name: destroys character sprites on shutdown
tests.title: BootScene destroys character sprites on shutdown
tests.scenario: Given BootScene created the boy sprite, When the SHUTDOWN callback runs, Then the sprite destroy is called once
tests.detail: Shutdown callback captured from events.once and invoked; sprite.destroy called once.

tests.name: creates no sprite when the scene has no characters
tests.title: BootScene creates no character sprite when the scene has no characters
tests.scenario: Given scene.characters is empty, When create() runs, Then add.sprite is not called
tests.detail: Original characters array restored in finally.

tests.name: only emits characterClick when the character has no interact animation
tests.title: BootScene emits characterClick without playing interact when the character has no interact animation
tests.scenario: Given the boy character has no interact animation, When the sprite receives pointerdown, Then characterClick {id:'boy'} is emitted and play is not called

tests.name: creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.title: BootScene creates one sprite per character and plays idle
tests.scenario: Given one boy character with idle in the manifest, When create() runs, Then one sprite is added and played with character:boy:idle

tests.name: plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.title: BootScene plays the interact animation when the character is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the boy sprite was created, When pointerdown fires, Then character:boy-interact:interact is played

tests.name: emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact on pointerdown
tests.title: BootScene emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact
tests.scenario: Given the boy sprite was created with the bus spied, When pointerdown fires, Then characterClick {id:'boy'} is emitted and interact plays
